newsWatch.originalDiscoveryTitle: Formation Securities LLC Plans Tokenized Securities Venue for Early 2027

sourceReview.reason: Formation Securities' original announcement dated 2026-11-09 confirms notice of intent to operate a Solana tokenized-securities venue, anticipated early-2027 trading, and planned participation of Exodus, Forward Industries and Galaxy Digital shares; this is a proposed venue, not an operating launch. Full company release: https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/formation-securities-notifies-sec-of-intent-to-operate-first-tokenized-securities-venue-on-solana-302932907.html . Evidence is available, but source_review.py seal and news_quality.py cannot be executed because local Git checkout fails DNS resolution of github.com; hold pending executable seal.
